title: XikeStor 4-Port 2.5G & 2-Port 10G Simple L2 Smart Managed Ethernet Network Switch

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your network performance with the XikeStor 4-Port 2.5G & 2-Port 10G Simple L2 Smart Managed Ethernet Network Switch.

This powerful switch offers a combination of 4 high-speed 2.5G ports and 2 ultra-fast 10G SFP+ uplink ports, ensuring seamless connectivity for all your devices.

Designed for small offices, home labs, and professional setups, it provides plug-and-play convenience with smart Layer 2 management features for enhanced control, security, and performance.


Key Features:

  • 4 × 2.5G RJ45 Ethernet ports
  • 2 × 10G SFP+ fiber uplink ports
  • Layer 2 Smart Managed features
  • Supports VLAN, QoS, and Port Trunking
  • Fanless, silent, and energy-efficient design
  • Compact metal housing for better durability
  • Plug-and-play setup with easy web interface

Ideal For:

  • Small businesses, gaming setups, and media professionals
  • NAS and server connectivity
  • High-speed LAN and data transfer environments
